sub_problems.fills: close.sh and prove.sh read the status of every commit, pull and push they run, and a repo left behind or diverged from origin stops the script loud, naming the repo, before it reports any crossing.
sub_problems.what: D1: close.sh's pull/push becomes sync_repo, whose failure or leftover unpushed commits stops the close with exit 5 before any crossing line.
sub_problems.why: Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces. 2026-11-20 on akiendelllinux, closing 380d524e6e9c: close.sh's commit_all (close.sh:23) ran `(cd $CC && cairn artifact quiet -- git pull -q --rebase --autostash && git push -q 2>&1 | tail -1)`; the pull printed 'fatal: Cannot rebase onto multiple branch
